en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 6, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include a settlement ensuring DC apartment accessibility, criticism of the EU's updated disability rights strategy for lacking ambition, the launch of an accessible fashion brand by model Tasha Ghouri, and a city council vote to study ADA compliance at City Hall.

highlights.title: Equal Rights Center Reaches Agreement to Ensure Accessibility for People with Disabilities at D.C. Apartment Building - Morningstar
Update of EU Disability Rights Strategy lacks ambition to advance our rights
Tasha Ghouri launches 'accessible' fashion brand and webstore
City Council Approves Study on ADA Accessibility at City Hall

zh-TW.title: 每日無障礙消息摘要 – 2026年5月6日
zh-TW.summary: 今日重點包括華盛頓特區公寓無障礙和解協議、歐盟殘疾人權利戰略更新被批評缺乏野心、模特Tasha Ghouri推出無障礙時尚品牌，以及市議會批准研究市政廳ADA無障礙合規情況。

highlights.title: 平等權利中心達成協議，確保殘障人士在華盛頓特區公寓大樓的可及性
歐盟殘疾人權利戰略更新缺乏野心，未能推進權利
塔莎·古里推出『無障礙』時尚品牌及網店
市議會批准對市政廳進行ADA無障礙研究
